name: Hotel Gasthof Fuchs
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Hotel Gasthof Fuchs is located in Matrei am Brenner in the Wipptal valley. The location is characterized by the surrounding mountain landscape of the Stubaier and Zillertaler Alpen. The house offers rooms in alpine style and a restaurant serving Tiroler cuisine. In the summer, the inn serves as a starting point for on surrounding trails. In the winter, guests can reach the ski resorts Stubai and Bergeralm. The facilities include a sauna and sunbathing lawns. The town is situated on the Brennerautobahn and the railway line.
